argv: set -eu; f=/etc/sudoers.d/zz-orbit-doctor-proof; printf 'orbit ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL, !/usr/sbin/ufw\n' > "$f.tmp"; chmod 0440 "$f.tmp"; visudo -cf "$f.tmp" >/dev/null; mv -f "$f.tmp" "$f"; if sudo -n -u orbit sudo -n /usr/sbin/ufw status >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'ufw is still permitted for orbit' >&2; exit 1; fi; echo 'app-prod: orbit may no longer run ufw through sudo (role inspector must fail closed)'
set -eu; rm -f /etc/sudoers.d/zz-orbit-doctor-proof; sudo -n -u orbit sudo -n /usr/sbin/ufw status >/dev/null; echo 'app-prod: sudo access for orbit restored'
